what_is_dudhiya_desc1: Dudhiya is a comprehensive digital platform designed to transform how milk collection centers and dairy farmers manage their operations. It replaces traditional paper registers, manual calculations, and complicated spreadsheets with an intuitive, automated system.
what_is_dudhiya_desc2: Built specifically for the Indian dairy industry, Dudhiya understands the unique challenges of milk collection, FAT/SNF calculations, farmer payments, and report generation. Our platform handles everything from recording daily collections to generating automated payment reports.
who_is_for_title: Perfect for Buyers & Suppliers in Dairy Business
who_is_for_subtitle: Whether you're buying milk from farmers or supplying milk to collection centers, Dudhiya simplifies your entire workflow

financial_management_desc: Consolidated payment tracking, expense management, and profit analysis
individual_farmers_desc: Track your daily milk deliveries, monitor earnings, and stay connected with your collection center

faq1_answer: Yes! For farmers (suppliers), Dudhiya is completely free. For collection centers (buyers), the first month is free. After that, affordable subscription plans are available based on your collection volume.
faq2_question: Can I switch between Buyer and Supplier roles?
faq2_answer: Yes! You can easily switch roles from the app settings. Each role has its own dashboard and features tailored to that user type.
faq3_answer: Absolutely. All data is encrypted and stored securely in the cloud with automatic backups. Even if you lose your phone, your data remains safe.
final_cta_title: Ready to Transform Your Dairy Business?
final_cta_subtitle: Join 10,000+ dairy professionals who trust Dudhiya for their daily operations.
step1_2_desc: Open the app and tap "Sign Up". Enter your phone number and verify with OTP.
step1_3_desc: Select "Buyer" for collection centers or "Supplier" for dairy farmers.
step1_4_desc: Add your name, dairy/collection center name, address, and other details.
step2_1_desc: Tap "Add Farmer" button. Enter name, phone number, and assign a unique code.
step2_2_desc: See all your connected farmers in one place. Search, filter, and manage easily.
step2_3_desc: Tap on any farmer to update their information, phone number, or assigned code.
step2_4_desc: Farmers automatically see their connected collection center in their app.
step3_1_desc: Choose the date and select Morning or Evening collection session.
step3_2_desc: Select farmer, enter milk quantity (in liters), FAT and SNF values.
step3_3_desc: Dudhiya automatically calculates payment based on your rate chart settings.
step3_4_desc: Tap "Save" to record the entry. Continue adding more collections for other farmers.
step4_1_desc: Access today's collection summary with total milk, farmers count, and total payment.
step4_2_desc: Tap "Generate PDF" to create a professional report with all collection details.
